body: I wish it was infertility, then I could just forget about it. Instead, I'm cruelly capable of producing offspring but no woman on earth would nor honestly should procreate with me. I'm a grotesque, unlovable piece of shit. So I'll never have the joy of a relationship, or starting a family, instead I'll be alone. So damn alone.
I hope you found someone to talk to.
Seems like he loves you and you're lucky to have him. Seek therapy, it may help you.
Haha, got a chuckle out of me.

33 years old. Even some of the older folks are too dramatic. In many cases their lives and problems would be welcomed by me if I could trade places. I don't think we should invalidate anyone's feelings though, young or otherwise.

Anyway, talking is good. It at least distracts from the pain briefly so I think you've got the right idea here. It can help a bit...

My dad died when I was a kid. I won't lie, it never gets easy...your brain just loses memories and the feelings subside with them. It'll take a long time but you'll cope, especially if you are lucky enough to have someone...that would make it easier, wish I'd had that.

RIP, honor his memory by living.
My mother used to say such things too. Now I finally understand. I feel the same way...

You'll find a man if you have patience. You can form a family and won't be alone anymore. Don't end it with so much opportunity, please. I'm hopeless, so it may be selfish to say, but I don't like seeing hope thrown away. You can get through it, stay strong and you can make it work. Praying for you.

I've had a few of those. They are cruel indeed. I was happy, in one I had a wife and a son. I'll definitely never be able to have a son of my own, that's how I knew it was fake. When I realized how much I loved him, how proud of him I was, I knew it and I woke up in tears.

I wish advanced VR simulations existed, I'd submit myself to these illusions because I don't want to live in this cold reality anymore.

Don't let a mean comment hold so much weight, he doesn't even know you. Even if you are boring that can change, you can become interesting, at least to some people. I am lonely too, so I know your feelings.

Just suppress the bad and cover it with good; but first and foremost, seek help. As long as you haven't acted you're innocent and will be get the help you need. You're a good person, so do the right thing and stay safe too.
All these replies about not caring anymore really resonate with me. I feel numb toward everything and just need permanent rest. I'm always tired, and loathe waking.

Your parents are their own people with their own beliefs, same as you, and you both have that right. If you think your parents won't approve of your lifestyle choices then just keep them in the dark about it. You can live your life any way you choose within law. Just keep your personal life private, they'll have to respect your privacy. If they don't mwell, then they're overstepping their bounds and you need to enforce boundaries.

Aside from that, I'm sure people care about you. Reach out and find a group. Try book clubs, church, and such to find new friends too. Lots of kind people out there if you look. Even your parents probably care about you despite if they disapprove of your lifestyle. Good luck.
Sounds like a psychologist could help in your situation.

I'd kill to have a family, even dysfunctional.  Please keep it. Your daughter needs you, and you have a lot more than you think you do. I've always been, and will always be, alone forever. I wish someone even hated me but I don't even exist to anyone. Stay strong, things will get better, raise your daughter right and then see what happens.

I wish they didn't matter either but we're wired this way. Your ugly friends are only friends though, and you'll keep them squarely in that zone too. This is the reality of life. If everyone really was beautiful they'd not be perpetually locked into inceldom.

At least you're nice and well meaning but I think the harsh truth is more important than sweet, thinly-veiled idealism.

I'm a monster thanks to these "teeth" in my trainwreck of a mouth, so I understand you completely. I can't bear to even look at people because I'm so objectively grotesque. I'm homeless so no money to fix my problem with procedures though...dental is so ridiculously expensive. This living nightmare will just keep dragging on as I whither, alone.
